summary.intent: Ship a release-PR improvement (#473: 'Read before merging' callout) and a grouped changelog layout feature produced by a delegated subagent, while cleaning up stale worktrees and branches in the callisto repo.
summary.outcome: PR #473 was opened with a signed commit and the changelog-layout agent's work was reviewed in a clean worktree, fixed (origin fallback for the repository, release-notes merge by bump group, docs/changeset corrections), fully verified, and committed. Pushing that commit and opening its PR had not yet happened, and ten remote branches, old worktree directories and the main checkout pull were left for the user.

repo: Pre-push verification is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test`, plus two workflow contract scripts; all must exit 0.
Existing test 'body from the preview equals body from the plan' catches divergence between the version preview and compose-pr-body paths, so both must share one function.
Adding a field to `VersionOptions` would break ~15 struct literals, so `plan_version_dated(.., date)` was added with `plan_version` delegating with `None`.
`ChangelogInput` gained a `style` field; existing literals use `style: Default::default()` (flat) while the configured default is grouped; `[changelog] layout = "flat"` keeps the old format.

Compare link repository comes from `[release] forge-repository`, else falls back to the origin remote (added during review); `[release]` requires at least one `[[release.artifact]]`, so the config-only rule would rarely produce a link.

Fixed-group GitHub release notes in `release/notes.rs` append mates' entries flat under the owner's last heading, which misfiled them under the wrong bump heading; fixed to file entries under the group they were recorded in.
`git worktree remove` also deletes ignored files, so plans and patches stored in a worktree are lost; keep plans in the main `.claude/plans/` folder.
`.entire/logs` is Entire tooling output and must stay out of commits.
Versioning docs state the link rule in docs/config.md, docs/architecture/versioning.md and docs/specs/versioning.json (criterion VER-APPLY-07A), all of which had to be updated together.

code.finding: Merge of extra group entries into `groups[group.unwrap_or(2)]` now trims trailing blank lines and only inserts a blank separator when the previous line is not a bullet or indented line, so appended entries follow the previous bullet directly.
Origin-remote repository lookup was added once per plan next to `tags` as a fallback when `[release] forge-repository` is unset.

workflow: Subagent reports are not authoritative: copying their changes into a clean worktree off origin/main and reviewing the real diff surfaced a wrong-heading bug and stale docs.
Agent sandboxes lack network, so network-dependent e2e tests (uv lock, polyglot lifecycle) failed there but passed when run in the main session.
Mutation checks (reverting a behavior and confirming tests fail) were used to validate new tests.
Verify a destructive cleanup's side effects before running it; the classifier refused remote branch deletion with unmerged commits, so those were deferred to the user.

friction: Removing the macos-15-runners worktree deleted the plan file and archived patches because they were ignored files inside it.
The classifier refused deleting remote branches holding unmerged commits, leaving ten for the user.
Subagent sandbox blocked network, so 3 tests could not run and parity with main was unconfirmed.
The subagent could not touch `notes.rs` (off-limits), leaving the mate-heading bug without a test until the main session fixed it.
A python patch script and `cargo fmt` reflow conflicted, requiring a re-read and re-patch of the notes.rs block.
open_items: Push the changelog-layout commit and open its PR (the commit was made but not pushed in this transcript).
#473 needs a GitHub review and CI to finish; labels and the preview path rule wait until it merges.
cli-io-2 agent is still running; its work needs review, signing and push.
Ten remote branches with unmerged commits await the user's decision on deletion; tips are saved in plans/archive/remote-branch-tips-2026-11-08.txt.
About 14 old directories under `.claude/worktrees/` that git no longer lists remain untouched.
The user's main checkout is far behind and needs pulling.
Unverified: a real release run with a real tag and repository, and percent-encoding of tags with special characters in the compare URL.
